claim: Under the explicit prepared-input policy, each length-three word over the fixed source-bound pattern has a source-typed query constructor that consumes the retained request and prepared native family and derives the correct native E selection, without taking the target region index, point or color as an answer parameter.
construction: Compile a word-indexed native WG P-table whose premises are native E selections from the retained prepared region family. Query it using an E-rule indexed by the request WORD. No target-region-index argument is accepted. No new seed policy or selected-output seeds are introduced.

interfaces.compiler: A disclosed host compiler tabulates the fixed geometric word-sum map before receiving a request or any color values. This is not derivation of an arithmetic law from particle dynamics.
interfaces.request_parser: The existing actual-packet trace replayer/decoder supplies a three-letter Word value; the complete incoming trace remains retained and independently checked.
interfaces.native_core: Actual NativeTableRules P/E Resolve applications, using retained row premises from RamseyRegionFamily.UnderInput.family.
interfaces.geometry_observation: A source-derived region-coordinate sidecar is checked against every quoted prepared context. Safe Cubical checks the word-sum square for this declared observation; sector geometry binding remains runtime verified.

proofs: native query value retains the requested Word and selected region row/color
each query retains all 27 word premises and every one of the 171 region premises beneath each
the selected region's declared geometric point equals the word sum for all 27 words
strongest_hostile: Change word111's compiled index to the origin. Its native-only Resolve program must still typecheck, while the geometric-square module must fail. This distinguishes native syntax validity from correct task realization.
acceptance: Fresh safe Cubical positive/native-only/wrong-square/wrong-premise checks and independent arithmetic for all 27 requests; runtime responses agree with the exact compiled native program and retained input data under changed color functions.
boundary: Bounded compiled native WG query program under the unchanged prepared-input policy. Host trace decoding and table compilation remain explicit. No autonomous native controller, kernel interpretation of sector JSON, physical policy admission, arbitrary pattern/length or Ramsey forcing is established.
